plang.note: 10 of 10 runs green (5 plan folder, 5 full)

findings.issue: Flaky: green alone (15/15), red in the plan folder in 6 of 8 clean runs (also with parallel=1), red in 2 of 5 full runs. Error: '%logged% is not set' - the binding made after the save did not fire in the resumed run. A failed run leaves workspace/resumed.marker, so every later run, even alone, fails the same way until it is deleted.
findings.impact: A red plang name in the plan's own folder; the binding-taken-in-at-birth behaviour is not reliably proven, and a failure poisons its own re-runs.
findings.suggestion: Find why the maker's binding is missing in the resumed sub app when other tests ran in the process (the architect's pending 'keep a binding once on resume' may be it); delete the marker at the top of Start so a failed run cannot poison the next.
findings.status: fixed at c1e1a9248 (identity race fix); 0 of 10 runs red

findings.issue: ResumeChain_MultiActionStep_ContinuesAtActionIndexPlusOne is Assert.That(true).IsTrue(), pointing at a fixture (StatelessCrossGoalResumes) this branch moved out. Mutation: Rest's `if (!again) return await Step!.Code.Start(context, at + 1, result)` -> `return result` leaves all 5641 C# and 308 plang tests green.
findings.impact: A resume could drop every action that follows a returned call in the same step and no test would notice.
findings.suggestion: A CallSnapshotTests case with a multi-action step ('goal.call X ; variable.set ...') saved inside X and resumed; assert the action after the call ran exactly once. Delete the placeholder.

findings.issue: Mutation `at + 1` -> `at` on the same line (a call whose callee returned runs again) leaves every suite green. FreshAppGoesOn cannot tell: Record resets %count% and %where%, so a double run ends on the same 'Alice in Reykjavik 1 yes'.
findings.impact: A resume that re-runs each call it resumes through passes the plan's plang proof.
findings.suggestion: Make the effects non-idempotent: Sub and Record's tail each append to a file; assert exactly one line each.

findings.issue: Five of seven main behaviours have no .test.goal: bindings inherited by sub apps, %!event% across a save, edit-the-stop-point-sign-resume, the changed-goal warning, the live program untouched. All are C#-pinned.
findings.impact: The developer-facing form (set %snap...%, sign, resume; on event steps) is unproven in plang.
findings.suggestion: Plang tests for %!event%, bindings in a resumed run, and edit -> sign -> resume at a changed step; the warning stays C# unless a goal can be rebuilt between save and resume.

findings.suggestion: Rewrite both to what exists and what landed.

findings.suggestion: Assert the goal name and step index in the warning; assert what the callback resumes to.
